back: Estimating future demand (sales) for a product over a given period, using judgement, research or past sales.
To plan production, purchasing and stock, staffing, cash budgets, finance and marketing.
Opinion of sales staff, expert opinion, consumer surveys of buying intentions (useful for new products).
Trends from past sales: average change, percentage growth, moving averages, extending a line graph.
Latest figure + average change per period (average change = total change ÷ number of changes).
Demand that rises and falls at the same times each year (uniforms in January, cold drinks in hot months).
Changes in tastes, new competitors, economic changes, weather, government policy, trends not continuing.
Long-range forecasts: the further ahead, the more can change.
